title: RNA and DNA Virus Detection
author: Lily Tong
materials: 13. Prepare the A-Tail mix (for multiple samples prepare a master mix with 10% excess): A B 1 Component Volume (μl) 2 10X A-Tail buffer 2.5 3 A-Tail enzyme 1.5 4 Total 4 KAPA LTP library prep kit Roche Catalog #796188001

1.4X SPRI clean up. SPRI is a solution containing 20% PEG 8000 and 2.5 M NaCl and allows for Ampure clean up using the beads contained within the reaction. SPRI is included as art of the KAPA LTP library prep kit but if required additional SPRI can be made by mixing equal quantities of 40% PEG 8000 and 5 M NaCl. 40% Polyethylene Glycol MW 8000 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P1458 5 M Sodium chloride (NaCl) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #S5150-1L

Quantify 1 µL using Qubit high sensitivity dsDNA. Qubit™ dsDNA HS Assay Kit Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #Q32851 Qubit (Flurometer, Invitrogen, Q33228, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/Q33228 , https://s3.amazonaws.com/pr-journal/9de3sqe.jpeg )

Quantify the DNA and RNA concentration of your samples using Qubit HS reagents. Qubit™ dsDNA HS Assay Kit Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #Q32851 Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #Q32852 Qubit (Flurometer, Invitrogen, Q33228, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/Q33228 , https://s3.amazonaws.com/pr-journal/9de3sqe.jpeg ) Depending on the sample type the level of RNA/DNA may be undetectable and so quantification may not be required for all samples.

steps.title: Split extracts for RNA/DNA
steps.instruction: Divide each nucleic‑acid extract into two equal subsamples for RNA and DNA virus detection; if needed, bring each subsample to a final volume of 50 µL with nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Label PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare two 0.2 mL PCR tubes per sample, label one “R” (RNA pre‑treatment) and one “D” (DNA pre‑treatment) together with the sample name; for many samples use strip tubes or plates and keep RNA and DNA subsamples grouped.

steps.title: Aliquot subsamples
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of the RNA subsample to tube R and 25 µL of the DNA subsample to tube D. Process the RNA tubes first to minimise degradation.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I mix
steps.instruction: For each RNA sample prepare a DNase I master mix (10 % excess) containing 2 µL 10× DNase I buffer and 3 µL Ambion™ RNase‑free DNase I (Thermo Fisher Cat# AM2224) for a total of 5 µL per reaction.

steps.title: DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL DNase I mix to each 25 µL RNA tube, mix, incubate at 37 °C for 15 min, then place on ice.

steps.title: RNAClean XP bead cleanup (RNA)
steps.instruction: Add 2 × volume (50 µL) of Agencourt RNAClean XP magnetic beads (Beckman Coulter Cat# A63987) to each DNase‑treated RNA, vortex beads (equilibrated ~30 min at RT), incubate 5 min at RT, place on magnetic rack until solution clears, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol, air‑dry ≤5 min (avoid over‑drying), elute RNA with 12 µL nuclease‑free water, incubate 2 min at RT.

steps.title: Add RNAClean XP beads to DNase reaction
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL RNAClean XP beads to the 30 µL DNase I reaction (the 25 µL RNA + 5 µL DNase mix) and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Transfer RNA for rRNA depletion
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of the DNase‑treated RNA to a fresh 0.2 mL tube for Illumina Ribo‑Zero Plus rRNA depletion (Cat# 20040526).

steps.title: Prepare hybridisation probe mix
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare a master mix (10 % excess) containing 3 µL DB1 (Depletion Probe Buffer) and 1 µL DP1 (Depletion Probe Pool) for a total of 4 µL per sample.

steps.title: Hybridise probes to RNA
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL hybridisation probe mix to each 10 µL RNA sample, pipette up/down 10 times, then incubate 95 °C for 2 min followed by a ramp down of 0.1 °C / s to 37 °C and hold (≈15 min total).

steps.title: Prepare rRNA depletion mix
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare a master mix (10 % excess) containing 4 µL RDB (RNA Depletion Buffer) and 1 µL RDE (RNA Depletion Enzyme) for a total of 5 µL per sample.

steps.title: rRNA depletion incubation
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL rRNA depletion mix to each 14 µL hybridisation reaction, pipette 10 times, incubate 37 °C for 15 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare probe removal mix
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare a master mix (10 % excess) containing 7 µL PRB (Probe Removal Buffer) and 3 µL PRE (Probe Removal Enzyme) for a total of 10 µL per sample.

steps.title: Probe removal incubation
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL probe‑removal mix to each 19 µL reaction, pipette 10 times, incubate 37 °C for 15 min, then 70 °C for 15 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: RNAClean XP bead cleanup (post‑depletion)
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL RNAClean XP beads to each 30 µL reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at RT, place on magnetic rack until clear, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 175 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol, air‑dry 2 min (do not over‑dry), elute in 12 µL ELB (Elution Buffer) by incubating 2 min at RT.

steps.title: Transfer RNA for cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of the depleted RNA to a fresh 0.2 mL tube for downstream cDNA preparation.

steps.title: Prepare NTP/Hex mix
steps.instruction: Make a master mix (10 % excess) containing 1 µL 10 mM dNTP (NEB Cat# N0447S) and 1 µL random hexamers (Thermo Scientific Cat# N8080127) for a total of 2 µL per sample.

steps.title: Anneal primers to RNA
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL NTP/Hex mix to each 10 µL RNA, incubate 65 °C for 5 min, then place immediately on ice.

steps.title: Prepare SSIII master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (10 % excess) per sample containing 4 µL 5× SuperScript III RT buffer, 2 µL SuperScript III (Thermo Fisher Cat# 18080044), 1 µL RNaseOUT (Thermo Fisher Cat# 10777019), and 1 µL 100 mM DTT; total 8 µL per reaction.

steps.title: First‑strand cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Add 8 µL SSIII master mix to each 12 µL annealed RNA, mix, and incubate according to the kit’s protocol (typically 25 °C 10 min, 50 °C 50 min, 85 °C 5 min, hold 4 °C).

steps.title: Prepare second‑strand mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (10 % excess) containing 8 µL 10× Second‑strand synthesis buffer, 4 µL Second‑strand synthesis enzyme, and 48 µL nuclease‑free water (NEBNext Ultra II Non‑Directional RNA Second Strand Synthesis Module, Cat# E6111L) for a total of 60 µL per sample.

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis incubation
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL second‑strand mix to each 20 µL first‑strand reaction (total 80 µL), incubate 16 °C for 2 h 30 min, hold 4 °C; then incubate 25 °C 10 min, 55 °C 1 h, 70 °C 15 min, hold 4 °C.

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup (cDNA)
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL Agencourt AMPure XP beads (1:1 ratio) to each 80 µL cDNA reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at RT, place on magnetic rack until clear, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 27 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0; store at 4 °C (overnight) or –20 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Pre‑bind MBD2‑Fc to beads
steps.instruction: For each DNA sample, pipette 1 µL Protein A magnetic beads (per 6.25 ng DNA; use 5 µL beads if DNA <30 ng) into a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 0.1 µL MBD2‑Fc protein, mix on a rotating mixer for 10 min at RT (do not vortex beads).

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Prepare 1× Bind/Wash buffer on ice (800 µL 5× Bind/Wash buffer + 3 200 µL nuclease‑free water = 4 mL total). Add DNA (up to 1 µg) to 1× buffer (minimum 40 µL, maximum 200 µL) and mix; then add the washed Fc‑bead/protein mixture, mix, and incubate on a rotating mixer at RT for 15 min–4 h (minimum 30 min recommended).

steps.title: Wash bound beads
steps.instruction: After incubation, spin briefly, place tube on magnetic rack for 5 min, remove supernatant, add 1 mL 1× Bind/Wash buffer, pipet up/down, rotate 3 min at RT, spin, magnetic rack 5 min, discard supernatant; repeat wash once more (total two washes).

steps.title: Elute microbiome DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in volume of 1× Bind/Wash buffer equal to the original bead volume, then place tube on magnet for ≥5 min, transfer the supernatant (host‑depleted microbiome DNA) to a fresh tube; optionally clean with 2× AMPure beads (per calculation sheet) for storage; if needed, bring volume to 55 µL with 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0.

steps.title: Set up Covaris sonicator
steps.instruction: Fill Covaris LE220 water tank to level –2, set chiller to 7 °C, turn on water‑conditioning system and computer, select Home so the transducer submerges and the degas pump starts, degas water bath for ~45 min.

steps.title: Sonicate DNA samples
steps.instruction: Add 55 µL DNA to each 8‑microTUBE‑50 AFA Fiber Strip V2 or 96‑microTUBE AFA Fiber Plate, place holder in instrument, close door, start run with parameters: Peak Power 450 W, Duty Factor 10 %, Cycles/Burst 1000, Treatment Time 89 s, Dithering on (produces ~350 bp fragments).

steps.title: Transfer sheared DNA
steps.instruction: After sonication, remove the plate, transfer 50 µL sheared DNA to PCR tubes; optionally assess fragment size by loading 1 µL on Agilent TapeStation (gDNA ScreenTape, Cat# 5067‑5365).

steps.title: Post‑sonication AMPure 1.4× cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 70 µL AMPure XP beads (1.4:1 bead:sample ratio) to each sample, incubate 15 min at RT, place on magnetic rack until clear, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 25 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0; store at 4 °C (overnight) or –20 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: End‑repair reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (10 % excess) containing 3 µL 10× End‑Repair buffer and 2 µL End‑Repair enzyme (KAPA LTP kit, Roche Cat# 796188001) for a total of 5 µL per sample; add 5 µL to each 25 µL DNA, incubate 20 °C for 30 min (no hot lid).

steps.title: AMPure 1.4× cleanup (post‑end‑repair)
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 to bring volume to 50 µL, then add 70 µL AMPure XP beads (1.4:1), mix, incubate 5 min RT, magnetic separation, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 21 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (beads remain in solution).

steps.title: A‑tailing reaction
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL A‑tail mix to each 21 µL reaction, incubate 30 °C for 1 h, then add 25 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 to bring volume to 50 µL.

steps.title: AMPure 1.4× cleanup (post‑A‑tail)
steps.instruction: Add 70 µL SPRI beads (1.4:1) to each 50 µL reaction, mix, incubate 5 min RT, place on magnetic rack until clear, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 15 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (beads remain in solution).

steps.title: Prepare ligation mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (10 % excess) containing 5 µL 5× ligation buffer and 2.5 µL DNA ligase (KAPA LTP kit, Roche Cat# 796188001) for a total of 7.5 µL per sample.

steps.title: Ligation incubation
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL ligation mix to each 14 µL A‑tailed reaction (beads present), then add 5 µL diluted NEBNext adapter, incubate 20 °C for 1 h (no hot lid).

steps.title: Add USER enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 0.75 µL USER enzyme (NEBNext Multiplex Oligos kit, Cat# E6440‑8) to each ligation, mix, then add 25 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 to bring volume to 50 µL, incubate 5 min at RT.

steps.title: Post‑ligation cleanup
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnetic rack until beads separate, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry ≤5 min (avoid over‑drying), elute in 22 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0.

steps.title: Add UDI primers
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of the eluate to a new 0.2 mL tube, add 5 µL NEBNext multiplex oligos (UDI primers, Cat# E6440‑8) – essential to prevent index hopping.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL KAPA HotStart ReadyMix (KAPA HiFi PCR kit, Cat# KK2601) to each tube. Run PCR: 98 °C 45 s; 4‑20 cycles of 98 °C 15 s, 65 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 1 min; hold 4 °C. Cycle number depends on input DNA (e.g., 2 µg → 1 cycle, 100 ng → 6‑7 cycles, 10 ng → 9‑11 cycles, 1 ng → 13‑15 cycles, etc.).

steps.title: Post‑PCR SPRI cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 45 µL SPRI beads (0.9:1 bead:sample ratio) to each PCR product, incubate 5 min RT, place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 20‑30 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (volume not specified in source; typical 20 µL).

steps.title: Library QC and pooling
steps.instruction: Quantify libraries, assess size distribution, pool libraries at equal molarity, retain a small unpooled aliquot for targeted enrichment; follow the “Library pooling and quality control for Illumina sequencing” protocol.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence pooled libraries on an Illumina platform according to the manufacturer’s guidelines; for metagenomic viral discovery aim for ~40 million reads per sample (≈20 M for RNA‑virus detection and 20 M for DNA‑virus detection).
